consensus_and_tokenomics.topic: 583-Day Flash Halving & Consensus Combo Jackpot Invariant Proof

achievements.description: Proved mathematically that 583-day halving convergence strictly satisfies 21,000,000.00000000 BTC-K total supply cap with 0 SatK drift.
Designed 3 canonical disposition paths for un-hit combo jackpot funds: 1) Rolling Jackpot Accumulator (Powerball model), 2) Dynamic difficulty decay/burn, 3) DAO Staking pool reserve.

achievements.description: Analyzed 1.3s - 1.7s block cadence vs 1.0s target; identified CPU single-threaded ASIC simulation hashing latency as root cause and compared against Kaspa's parallel GHOSTDAG ASIC architecture.

stratum_mining_infrastructure.topic: Go-Stratum + Redis Commercial Pool Frontend & ASIC Gateway

achievements.description: Built Stratum V1 mining pool gateway in Go (src/stratum_gateway_go/) and Python (src/stratum/stratum_server.py) with dynamic difficulty adjustment.
Prepared roadmap for scaling local test environment to 10 machines to benchmark DAG block convergence under parallel mining pressure.

cryptographic_privacy_engine.topic: Zero-KYC Monero / BIP-47 / Vitalik EIP-5564 Dual-Key Stealth Address Protocol

achievements.description: Maintained view key (v, V=v*G) and spend key (s, S=s*G) pure-python secp256k1 engine without external dependencies.
Verified sender ephemeral scalar r generating one-time output P = Spend_Pub + Hash(r*View_Pub)*G; verified recipient scan and spend derivation p = (s + c) mod N.
achievements.privacy_guarantee: Absolute wire-level un-linkability; external observers cannot correlate transactions to recipient or sender master stealth addresses.

headless_economy_and_safeguards.topic: Integration of Document 27 Headless Economy Architecture
design_principles: Balance != Authorization (余额 != 支出授权)
Metering & Accounting before Wallets (先做计量对账，再做钱包金融)
Proof of Delivery > Proof of Payment (交付证明优于转账证明)
State Machine with First-Class unknown_effect Handling

modules_created_or_upgraded.functionality: BIP-340 Schnorr signature by principal, hard budget caps, allowed service whitelist, execution boundary security blocking LLM prompt injections.
Enforces strict valid transitions; recovers from unknown_effect via Idempotency-Key query without double payment.
HTTP 402 SatK micropayments, RFC 7231 compliance, Schnorr signed proof of delivery, deduplicated idempotency cache, task-level audit log.
Automatic HTTP 402 handshake, delegation budget checks, idempotency injection, result hash delivery validation, safe timeout reconciliation.
